# Numbers and the clock in the game's language, fix/formats168 (1.21.11, the demo song, GUI scale 3). The test game's
# computer is set to English, so main shows every language the English way. Each shot, the branch against main:
# - formats168-<lang>-bar: the top bar's clock on the left of the bar. The time is the runner's own, so only its form
#   counts. en: "9:07 PM" style on both. de, ru, he: 24 hours on the branch ("21:07", German and Russian with a
#   leading zero before 10: "09:07"); main "9:07 PM" style. fr_ca: "21 h 07" style on the branch. es_mx: "9:07 p.m."
#   style on the branch; main "9:07 PM".
# - formats168-<lang>-lyrics: the Lyrics tab, Position card: Size reads "1,00×" on the branch in de and ru (main and he
#   "1.00×"), and the Floating Distance row (placement set to Floating) "10,7 Blöcke" / "10,7 бл." (main "10.7").
# - formats168-<lang>-timing: the settings searched for the Timing row (Timing set to +0.25 s): "+0,25 s" on the branch
#   in de and ru, "+0.25 s" on main and in he.
# - formats168-<lang>-key: the message above the hotbar after one press of Lyrics are late (put on "." by the script; ","
#   is Lyrics are early and takes it back after each shot): "+0,10 s" on the branch in de and ru (main "+0.10 s"); he
#   "+0.10 s" on both, the plus on the left, the "s" on the right.
# Run it, and with -f mod_ref=main for the old code (the script comes from --ref):
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/formats168 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/formats168.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/formats168 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=main -f script=.github/checks/formats168.txt

cmd weather clear
cmd time set noon
look 0 -20
guiscale 3
sleep 8
set placement FLOATING
set syncOffsetMs 250
bind skylyrics.lyrics_late period
bind skylyrics.lyrics_early comma
sleep 1

shot formats168-en-bar

lang de_de
sleep 15
shot formats168-de-bar
gui 0
sleep 2
shot formats168-de-lyrics
search Timing
sleep 2
shot formats168-de-timing
close
sleep 1
hold skylyrics.lyrics_late 60
sleep 0.6
shot formats168-de-key
hold skylyrics.lyrics_early 60
sleep 3

lang ru_ru
sleep 15
shot formats168-ru-bar
gui 0
sleep 2
shot formats168-ru-lyrics
search Синхронизация
sleep 2
shot formats168-ru-timing
close
sleep 1
hold skylyrics.lyrics_late 60
sleep 0.6
shot formats168-ru-key
hold skylyrics.lyrics_early 60
sleep 3

lang he_il
sleep 15
shot formats168-he-bar
gui 0
sleep 2
shot formats168-he-lyrics
search תזמון
sleep 2
shot formats168-he-timing
close
sleep 1
hold skylyrics.lyrics_late 60
sleep 0.6
shot formats168-he-key
sleep 3

lang fr_ca
sleep 15
shot formats168-frca-bar

lang es_mx
sleep 15
shot formats168-esmx-bar

lang en_us
sleep 15
